text_block_list.text:
Today's outing is at a "special spot"... 
recommended by Light Hello, apparently.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
It's quite a trip, but I promise you'll be 
moved! Please look forward to it, okay? ♪

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Ta-daaa! We have arrived!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
The starry sky from here is truly 
breathtaking! There's no one around, so we 
have it all to ourselves.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Fufu♪ ...Actually, this place happens to 
be my hometown!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Brings back memories... I used to do my 
training on this sandy beach back then.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
When I got tired, I'd lie down on the 
sandy beach. ...I used to make wishes on 
shooting stars all the time.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
"I want to go to Tracen Academy. I want to 
become a GⅠ Umamusume, just like Mom..."

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
When my wish came true and my enrollment 
was confirmed, I was so incredibly happy.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Parting with my friends was sad, but... 
everyone cheering to see me off is what 
gave me the push forward.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
...W-Well, yes. Though in the end, I never 
even got to run in a GⅠ race.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Still, thanks to that, I met my former 
Trainer and seniors. And... I was able to 
meet you.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: ........J-Just kidding.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
I'm so sorry out of nowhere……! I never 
intended to talk about this.
choice_data_list: Not at all, I'm actually really happy.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Ugh...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Because you're that kind of Trainer... 
maybe that's why I wanted you to hear this 
story—
(Glint)

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: ――Ah, a shooting star!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
All right! I managed to make three wishes! 
With this, my dream should definitely come 
true.
choice_data_list: What kind of favor is it this time?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
...Heheh♪ That's a secret! At least until 
I can say it with my head held high.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
To make that day come sooner, I've gotta 
work super hard starting tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
――And so! To build up our stamina for 
tomorrow, let's grab some food right here!

Right away, party of two coming in~! 
Wait... could that be Light Hello?!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello's Classmate
text_block_list.text:
Do you remember me? It's me, me! Come on, 
we were in the same class!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Wow, long time no see! Incredible... 
How did you even recognize me?!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello's Classmate
text_block_list.text:
You bet! I mean—just look at that poster 
right over there!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
...! This is... for the event I'm 
organizing upcoming...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello's Classmate
text_block_list.text:
I saw in the papers! You're working hard 
as a producer, right? I'm rooting for you!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: ...*gasp*!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
My feelings reached all the way out here, 
too. And they're still cheering me on even 
now...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: ...Gh, hehe...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: ...Heheh, yes!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! The day I can tell you my wish 
isn't that far off.
(*drip, ...drip...*)

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Cold! ...Wait, this... don't tell me...!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Eeeek! Is it really raining!? We need to 
take shelter, quickly...!

I quickly took shelter under a tree and 
waited for the rain to stop, but...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Achoo!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Brrr... The rain has completely chilled me 
to the bone.

...Oh my? Well if it isn't Hello! If 
you're visiting home, you should've let me 
know~!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Hey there~! What are you doing out here? 
You look like you're freezing...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Let me guess, caught in that rain earlier? 
Then come inside and put on a jacket at 
least!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
I-It's fine! I can handle it myself. I'm 
not a little kid anymore, you know!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Oh, stop trying to act tough! ...I know! 
Tonight, I'll make your favorite carrot 
spaghetti!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Huh? ...Is that so?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Eat something while you're at it! Come on, 
let's get going before you catch a cold~!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: ........ Um, Trainer...

And so, I visited Light Hello's family 
home and took a well-deserved rest.
